lessons.title: Briathra leathana: -aigh go -óidh
lessons.rule: For a verb that ends in -aigh, take away -aigh and add -óidh: ceannaigh becomes ceannóidh.
steps: Find the root of the verb: brostaigh.
Take away -aigh: brost.
Add -óidh: brostóidh.
Put the verb first, then the subject: Brostóidh sí abhaile i ndiaidh an chluiche.

lessons.title: Briathra caola: -igh go -eoidh
lessons.rule: For a verb that ends in -igh, take away -igh and add -eoidh: bailigh becomes baileoidh.
steps: Find the root of the verb: bailigh.
Take away -igh: bail.
Add -eoidh: baileoidh.
Put the verb first, then the subject: Baileoidh an múinteoir na fóin ag tús an ranga.

lessons.title: Briathra a thosaíonn ar ghuta nó ar f
lessons.en: Verbs beginning with a vowel or f: nothing in front
lessons.rule: A verb that begins with a vowel or f takes the same ending as any other, and nothing goes in front of it: there is no d' in the future (D'ullmhaigh sí in the past, but Ullmhóidh sí).
steps: Find the root of the verb: aeraigh.
Take away -aigh and add -óidh: aeróidh.
Put nothing in front of it, not even d': Aeróidh sé an seomra ranga ag am lóin.

example.prompt: (Aeraigh) sé an seomra ranga ag am lóin.
example.answer: Aeróidh sé an seomra ranga ag am lóin.

more.answer: Folmhóidh sé an mála scoile ar an tábla.

lessons.title: An fhoirm dhiúltach: Ní + séimhiú
lessons.en: Saying what will not happen: Ní + lenition
lessons.rule: To make the future negative, put Ní in front of the verb and add h after the first letter: ceannóidh becomes Ní cheannóidh. Verbs that begin with l, n or r show no change (Ní laghdóidh).
steps: Find the verb: Ceannóidh.
Put Ní in front of it.
Add h after the first letter: Ní cheannóidh mé aip nua don fhón.

example.prompt: Ceannóidh mé aip nua don fhón.
example.answer: Ní cheannóidh mé aip nua don fhón.

more.prompt: Baileoidh sé an bruscar sa pháirc.
more.answer: Ní bhaileoidh sé an bruscar sa pháirc.

lessons.hint: Ní + h after the first letter.

lessons.title: An fhoirm cheisteach: An + urú
lessons.rule: To write the question for an answer, put An in front of the verb and eclipse it (ceannóidh becomes An gceannóidh), and swap mé for tú or muid for sibh. Verbs that begin with l, n, r or s show no eclipsis (An socróidh sí?).
steps: Find the verb in the answer: Baileoidh.
Put An in front and eclipse it: b takes m, so An mbaileoidh.
The answer says mé, so the question asks tú: An mbaileoidh tú na fóin ag tús an ranga?

example.answer: An mbaileoidh tú na fóin ag tús an ranga?

more.answer: An bhfiosróidh sibh an cúrsa Gaeltachta?

lessons.hint: An + eclipsis; mé becomes tú, muid becomes sibh.

lessons.title: Guta i ndiaidh An agus Ní
lessons.en: Vowels after An and Ní: no change
lessons.rule: A verb that begins with a vowel never changes after An or Ní: An ullmhóidh tú? Ní ullmhóidh mé.
steps: Find the verb: Aimseoidh.
Put Ní in front of it.
It begins with a vowel, so leave it as it is: Ní aimseoidh sé a fhón sa mhála.

example.answer: Ní aimseoidh sé a fhón sa mhála.

more.answer: An ullmhóidh tú an lón don turas?

lessons.hint: A vowel after An or Ní stays the same.

lessons.title: An saorbhriathar: -ófar
lessons.rule: When you do not say who does the action, take away -aigh and add -ófar, with no pronoun after it: ceannaigh becomes ceannófar.
steps: Find the root: ceannaigh.
Take away -aigh and add -ófar: ceannófar.
Put it first, with no pronoun after it: Ceannófar fón nua roimh dheireadh na míosa.
